# netskope_aig_ai_provider_list (Data Source)

Lists all AI providers (predefined and custom) configured in the Netskope AI Gateway tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_ai_provider_list" "my_aigaiproviderlist" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `elements` (Attributes List) List of AI providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements))

<a id="nestedatt--elements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Hostname of the AI backend.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the AI provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the AI provider.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the AI backend.
- `protocol` (String) Connection protocol to the AI backend.
- `schema` (String) AI API schema the provider exposes.
- `type` (String) Provider type. Always "custom" for user-managed providers.
